title: Galley theme
description: A Galley editing-app theme: five seed colours per mode and four fixed switches. Nothing else — no selectors, no CSS, no sizes. See brand/themes/README.md.

contract.description: The version of the theme contract this file is written to.

id.description: Lower-case name, used in file names and on <html data-look>.

paper.description: The ground. Light: OKLCH lightness 0.93–0.995, chroma ≤ 0.035. Dark: lightness 0.14–0.27, chroma ≤ 0.035.

ink.description: Text. Light: lightness ≤ 0.32, chroma ≤ 0.05. Dark: lightness ≥ 0.90, chroma ≤ 0.04.

pencil.description: The accent: the one action, where you are, focus, the assistant's hand. Any hue and lightness; chroma ≥ 0.06.

plate.description: The dark material of a plate sidebar and status strip. Lightness ≤ 0.28 (dark mode: ≤ 0.22 and below the paper).

table.description: The warm ground under a page being proofed (the preview gutter). Light: lightness 0.80–0.93; dark: 0.24–0.34; chroma ≤ 0.06.

dark.description: Seeds for the dark mode. Optional: when absent they are derived from the light seeds (README → Dark from light).

sidebar.description: The sidebar's material: paper with the current page as a sheet; a toned desk; an inked plate (with the status line as a strip of it).

assist.description: Where the assistant works: its fields ruled in pencil, or its fields, pane, suggestions and selection washed in pencil.

icons.description: Icons at rest: one ink, or ink line with a pencil tint (in the sidebar, palette and collection lists).

depth.description: Soft: hairlines and a whisper of shadow. Lit: a crisp edge and a layered fall under sheets, lit and pressed buttons, recessed wells, the top bar as a band, stronger stamps.
